newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover halves in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover halves in thin trading.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest bourse drifted to half the previous session's level of 54 million lei as investor interest remained low.
Two independent indices fell to new year lows.
Traders said Tuesday's drop in turnover was to be expected as investors had slipped into a holiday mood.
"Big investors are busy working out year-end accounts and small investors seem more interested in Christmas shopping than in the bourse," said a trader.
"A turnover of 27 million lei for the penultimate session of the year is not that bad after all," another trader said.
He said the bourse would hold the last 1996 session on Thursday and resume trading on January 7, but the stock exchange did not make such an annoucement.
Whatever buying interest emerged on Tuesday focused on Azomures SA fertiliser maker, which took 67 percent of turnover and closed 100 lei stronger at 11,600.
Also in focus was engineering company Artrom SA in which 1,110 of the total 3,760 traded shares changed hands. Artrom closed 60 lei higher at 1,960.
Another five stocks pushed higher on Tuesday. Five prices drifted lower, two were flat and one stock had no trade.
Syringe maker Sanevit SA and Electroceramica SA insulators maker were suspended from trading pending announcements on their latest shareholders' meeting.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA, and Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- fell to year lows. The VAB dropped 2.5 percent to 266.6 points and the BIG was 2.47 percent down to 265.8 points.
